SUPERSESSION / MIGRATION RECORD — v1.7

CURRENT decisions supersede conflicting older descriptions while preserving provenance.

1. HEIMDALL
OLD: Workspace/information organization only.
CURRENT: Doorway to EDEN; ORGANIZE, UNDERSTAND, ACCESS & COMPOSE; owns Workspaces/information composition; creates Custom Apps; can initiate new App engineering. Universal access does not impose mandatory runtime dependency.

2. CONDUCTOR
OLD: global EDEN runtime orchestration/intelligence fabric.
CURRENT: HEIMDALL.CONDUCTOR — HEIMDALL-owned, EDEN-wide conversational/voice/command layer. Deterministic/offline baseline; actual voice independent of AI; optional native/local/provider AI. Domain/runtime authority remains with Apps, capabilities, orchestrators, AOS and BIFROST as appropriate.

3. LCAS
OLD: Apps/edenOS shared runtime Live Control, Activity & Status layer.
CURRENT: retired from Apps/edenOS runtime; retained as in-Chat UI identity. Runtime status/progress/control requirements migrate to truthful state contracts + actual UIX. UIbasic remains older legacy provenance.

4. FORGE
OLD: generic implementation/build role.
CURRENT: FORGE v2.0 authoritative general Software Engineering environment. Not all Engineering.

5. PROMETHEUS / DAEDALUS
OLD: companion Engineering Apps with exact Mechanical/Electrical mapping intentionally unresolved.
CURRENT: PROMETHEUS = Technology, Research & Prototype Development. DAEDALUS = Engineering Design, Systems & Realization. Old narrow mapping remains provenance only.

6. EITRI
CURRENT: Engineering Master Smith / Engineering Orchestrator across PROMETHEUS, DAEDALUS, focused Engineering Apps, FORGE, specialists and shared capabilities.

7. UIX
OLD: shared LCAS/UIbasic runtime status framing.
CURRENT: actual App/edenOS UIX. One EDEN UIX language with specialized professional environments; direct domain-object access; adaptive phone/tablet/desktop; immersive/focus states; provider complexity hidden by default; truthful state.
